boundary_semantics: Numeric admissibility only; syntactic/semantic constraints also apply. Resource counts at cap accept existing work; next admission rejects or evicts idle entries. Timeout vectors test expiration at deadline, not configurable enlargement. Status 101 is a WS-only exception. Header override 0 means inherit. Oversized WS rejection bodies are capture-truncated, not rejected. Time deadline boundaries refer to deadline expiration; configured timeout integer validation is separate. Header/body limits refer to decoded bytes unless name states encoded.

memory_accounting.ws_application: Reserve 2M before admission from 536870912; one complete in-flight message per direction, moved without application clone; release all reservation on rejection, cancellation, close and shutdown; not process RSS
